_from: docs/plans/stories/PLAN.md. Story paintings for Goblin Storm: one 1536x864 scene a page, filed as art/story/<story id>-<page>.webp. Matches docs/goblinstorm-art style a.

styles.a: Bright flat storybook fantasy illustration, clean shapes, soft light, cheerful saturated colours, friendly and inviting, a storybook picture for children aged 8 to 12, no blood, no gore, no scary faces, no romance, no text, no letters, no numbers.

pictures.name: goblinstorm-opening-1
pictures.prompt: A strange swirling green storm cloud with a cheeky grinning face rolling over sunny green fields towards a small stone castle. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: goblinstorm-opening-2
pictures.prompt: Hundreds of small cartoon green goblins falling from a green storm cloud like rain, with bats, bouncy slimes and one big troll, all running across fields towards a castle. Funny, not scary. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: goblinstorm-opening-3
pictures.prompt: A big bronze bell ringing in a stone castle tower, swinging, with motion lines and birds flying off, green storm clouds behind. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: goblinstorm-opening-4
pictures.prompt: A brave small hero standing in a glowing ring of sparkling gems in a green field, goblins coming from all sides, a grumpy goblin king with a club far in the distance. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: goblinstorm-hero-knight-1
pictures.prompt: a small knight in shiny silver armour with a blue plume and cape standing alone at a castle gate with arms folded, while guards run away in the background, goblins approaching. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: goblinstorm-hero-knight-2
pictures.prompt: A kind old grandmother knight in battered silver armour handing two shining swords to a small knight in shiny silver armour with a blue plume and cape, inside a cosy castle hall. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: goblinstorm-hero-knight-3
pictures.prompt: a small knight in shiny silver armour with a blue plume and cape with two shining swords spinning in a circle of light around them, goblins bouncing off. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: goblinstorm-hero-ranger-1
pictures.prompt: a small ranger in a green hood and brown leather with a bow walking through a giant dark forest with enormous tall trees, a few beams of sun far above. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: goblinstorm-hero-ranger-2
pictures.prompt: a small ranger in a green hood and brown leather with a bow in a forest with whirling green leaves, a diving hawk and a little swarm of friendly wasps helping against goblins. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: goblinstorm-hero-ranger-3
pictures.prompt: a small ranger in a green hood and brown leather with a bow drawing a bow on a hill, glowing gems flying towards them from far away, goblins in the distance. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: goblinstorm-hero-wizard-1
pictures.prompt: a small wizard in a purple robe and tall pointed hat with stars sneezing at a magic school library, a small funny puff of fire on a bookshelf, other students gasping. Cartoon, funny. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: goblinstorm-hero-wizard-2
pictures.prompt: a small wizard in a purple robe and tall pointed hat with stars practising fireballs at targets in a courtyard at sunset, many targets hit, one target a bit singed. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: goblinstorm-hero-wizard-3
pictures.prompt: a small wizard in a purple robe and tall pointed hat with stars casting a big bright fireball into the sky, little green goblins (green skin, big pointy ears, long noses, raggedy brown clothes, clearly goblins and not children) running away in a funny panic. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: goblinstorm-hero-barbarian-1
pictures.prompt: a big friendly barbarian with red hair and beard, fur vest and horned helmet laughing in a snowy mountain village, wrestling a friendly bear, people having a snowball fight. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: goblinstorm-hero-barbarian-2
pictures.prompt: a big friendly barbarian with red hair and beard, fur vest and horned helmet looking cross with steam puffing from the ears, cartoon style, snowy background. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: goblinstorm-hero-barbarian-3
pictures.prompt: a big friendly barbarian with red hair and beard, fur vest and horned helmet looking very cross at little green goblins (green skin, big pointy ears, long noses, raggedy brown clothes, clearly goblins and not children) running off with a lunch basket and a big sandwich. Funny. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: goblinstorm-hero-cleric-1
pictures.prompt: a small cleric in a white and gold robe with a glowing golden ring over the head polishing a bell in a little stone chapel next to an old peaceful graveyard, candles glowing. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: goblinstorm-hero-cleric-2
pictures.prompt: a small cleric in a white and gold robe with a glowing golden ring over the head gently bandaging the paw of a small fox at a chapel door, a bird with a bandaged wing nearby. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: goblinstorm-hero-cleric-3
pictures.prompt: a small cleric in a white and gold robe with a glowing golden ring over the head walking forward in a ring of warm golden holy light, goblins bouncing off the ring. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: goblinstorm-hero-rogue-1
pictures.prompt: a small quick rogue in a dark teal hood and scarf with two little daggers tiptoeing away at night from a goblin camp holding a golden crown, a sleeping goblin king wearing a saucepan on his head. Funny. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: goblinstorm-hero-rogue-2
pictures.prompt: A cross goblin king with a saucepan on his head shouting and pointing, a crowd of angry goblins behind. Funny, not scary. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: goblinstorm-hero-rogue-3
pictures.prompt: a small quick rogue in a dark teal hood and scarf with two little daggers dashing between goblins in a blur of teal shadows, goblins tumbling over. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: goblinstorm-hero-witch-1
pictures.prompt: a small frost witch in an icy blue dress and a snowflake hat, long pale hair, with a crystal wand on a snowy mountain top with a family of fluffy white snow owls sitting on the hat and shoulders. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: goblinstorm-hero-witch-2
pictures.prompt: a small frost witch in an icy blue dress and a snowflake hat, long pale hair, with a crystal wand smiling while goblins near the witch shiver and turn frosty blue, icicles on their noses. Funny. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: goblinstorm-hero-witch-3
pictures.prompt: a small frost witch in an icy blue dress and a snowflake hat, long pale hair, with a crystal wand sending glowing rings of frost out from the wand, snow owls flying happily around. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: goblinstorm-hero-dragonkid-1
pictures.prompt: a small child in a red dragon onesie with little horns, a spiky tail and small wings standing proudly with fists on hips, other children giggling and pointing in the background, a castle courtyard. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: goblinstorm-hero-dragonkid-2
pictures.prompt: a small child in a red dragon onesie with little horns, a spiky tail and small wings looking at a big storybook showing a scary dragon, thinking hard, a little determined frown. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: goblinstorm-hero-dragonkid-3
pictures.prompt: a small child in a red dragon onesie with little horns, a spiky tail and small wings breathing a puff of fire up into the air, little green goblins (green skin, big pointy ears, long noses, raggedy brown clothes, clearly goblins and not children) with surprised faces jumping away. Funny. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: goblinstorm-map-forest-1
pictures.prompt: A dark magical forest with giant glowing mushrooms, angry little mushroom creatures, wolves, and a big shadowy forest ogre in the distance. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: goblinstorm-map-graveyard-1
pictures.prompt: A misty haunted graveyard at night with friendly cartoon skeletons, little ghosts and a lich with a glowing staff in the distance. Spooky but cute, not scary. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: goblinstorm-map-peaks-1
pictures.prompt: Snowy frozen mountain peaks, yetis throwing huge snowballs, an ice dragon spreading its wings in the sky far above. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: goblinstorm-map-lava-1
pictures.prompt: A glowing underground lava mine with rivers of orange lava, red hot rocks, fire sprites, and a big fire dragon in the distance. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: goblinstorm-boss-castle-1
pictures.prompt: A grumpy goblin king wearing a saucepan as a crown running away across fields, dropping his club, a green storm cloud drifting towards a forest. Funny. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: goblinstorm-boss-forest-1
pictures.prompt: A big forest ogre sitting on the ground crying big cartoon tears, then stomping off into the trees. Funny, not sad. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: goblinstorm-boss-graveyard-1
pictures.prompt: A lich fading away into mist in a graveyard, candles flickering back on, a green storm cloud drifting up into the mountains. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: goblinstorm-boss-peaks-1
pictures.prompt: An ice dragon flying far away over mountains to sit sulking on a glacier, the green storm cloud sinking down into a mine below. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: goblinstorm-boss-lava-1
pictures.prompt: A castle at sunset with a big rainbow where the green storm used to be, people cheering, the castle bell ringing, heroes waving. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: goblinstorm-map-sunken-1
pictures.prompt: An underwater kingdom of sunken coral castles and swaying seaweed, cheeky fish-people sea raiders with tridents, glowing pink jellyfish, and a giant purple kraken wearing a little crown in the deep blue distance. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: goblinstorm-map-sky-1
pictures.prompt: A stone castle floating on clouds high in a stormy sky, stone gargoyles and bird-people flying around it, glowing rings on the castle floor, a huge blue storm giant with a lightning-bolt club among the clouds in the distance. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: goblinstorm-map-crystal-1
pictures.prompt: A glittering cave full of giant purple, pink and cyan crystals, little crystal beetles and crystal bats, a long shining crystal dragon coiled up in the distance. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: goblinstorm-map-swamp-1
pictures.prompt: A foggy green swamp at dusk, glowing green will-o'-the-wisps, lily pads and twisted trees, the shape of a three-headed serpent half hidden in the fog in the distance. Spooky but cute, not scary. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: goblinstorm-map-citadel-1
pictures.prompt: A huge dark castle on a mountain top inside a swirling green and blue storm, lightning flashing, blue storm goblins marching up the path, a goblin king made of storm clouds on the highest tower. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: goblinstorm-boss-sunken-1
pictures.prompt: A purple kraken with a little crown swimming away sulkily into the deep sea, letting go of a sunken ship, bubbles everywhere, fish cheering. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: goblinstorm-boss-sky-1
pictures.prompt: A big blue storm giant sitting on a cloud rubbing a bump on his head, his lightning-bolt club snapped in two, the storm clouds parting to show bright blue sky. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: goblinstorm-boss-crystal-1
pictures.prompt: A long crystal dragon curled up fast asleep in a glittering crystal cave, snoring little bubbles, the crystals glowing softly. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: goblinstorm-boss-swamp-1
pictures.prompt: The fog lifting off a green swamp in warm morning sun, a three-headed serpent sliding away under the water, frogs cheering on lily pads. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: goblinstorm-boss-citadel-1
pictures.prompt: A goblin king made of storm clouds bursting into a huge bright rainbow above a castle on a mountain top, goblins throwing their hats in the air, the sky clearing to gold. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: goblinstorm-gate-1
pictures.prompt: A giant glowing stone gate standing in the clouds swinging open, swirling storm light behind it, a path of floating islands leading away to five strange lands: a sunken sea kingdom, a castle in the sky, a crystal cave, a foggy swamp and a dark storm castle. Landscape, wide.
